newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW CLEARS MOSTOSTAL-Z NEW ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW CLEARS MOSTOSTAL-Z NEW ISSUE.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared the 2.6 million shares construction firm Mostostal Zabrze SA plans to sell in a public offering next month, KPW head Jacek Socha said on Friday.
"Mostostal Zabrze represents the forty-second raising of capital by firms already on the Warsaw bourse," Socha told a news conference.
Mostostal Zabrze President Leszek Pietrzak told Reuters that the price of the ex-rights issue would be set through book-building and should be around the stock's bourse price.
Mostostal closed on Friday at 11.3 zlotys on the bourse's main market.
Mostostal will offer two million shares in the large- investor tranche due on November 12 and 13 in which investors must subscribe for at least 20,005 shares.
In the small-investor tranche from November 12 to November 15 Mostostal will offer 600,000 shares.
Mostostal plans to use the proceeds from the issue largely to modernise firms in its holding.
